outcome: Healing outcomes after vaginal repair of cesarean section diverticulum
cohort: 167 patients diagnosed with cesarean section diverticulum who underwent vaginal repair between June 11, 2012, and May 27, 2016
finding: A nomogram incorporating depth/thickness of the remaining muscular layer ratio, number of menstruation days before surgery, white blood cell count, and fibrinogen levels can effectively predict outcomes after vaginal repair of cesarean section diverticulum.
